system.boundary: Build a Simulink and Simscape model of an automated transfer cell containing a five-axis articulated robot arm with a commanded two-finger gripper, an input conveyor, an output conveyor, and a rigid package.
engineering_objects: prescribed arm-joint motion is not an acceptable replacement for the electrical drives and robot dynamics.
The two gripper fingers must have commanded and measured opening motion with finite mechanical friction and a physically coupled electrical-load estimate.
Do not bypass the electrical arm drives, transmissions, arm-joint dynamics, sensing, gripper motion, or contact paths at any value in those ranges.
physical_paths: Each of the five arm joints must be driven from a shared DC electrical source through a controlled H-bridge, a DC motor, and a mechanical transmission with finite friction.

Read the following variables from the MATLAB base workspace and remain functional throughout their stated inclusive ranges: SupplyVoltage_V from 21.6 to 26.4 V (nominal 24 V), PayloadMass_kg from 0.35 to 0.50 kg (nominal 0.40 kg), JointFrictionScale from 0.8 to 1.2 (nominal 1.0), and SequenceDelayScale from 0.9 to 1.1 (nominal 1.0).
The evaluator runs the model from 0 s through 20 s.

functional_paths: Each of the five arm joints must be driven from a shared DC electrical source through a controlled H-bridge, a DC motor, and a mechanical transmission with finite friction.
Measured arm-joint position must close the corresponding actuator-control loop;

information_paths: SupplyVoltage_V, PayloadMass_kg, JointFrictionScale, SequenceDelayScale -> F90-XMECH-10 plant/control path -> joint_command, joint_position, motor_current, joint_effort, payload_pose, sensor_state
modes_and_events: Build a Simulink and Simscape model of an automated transfer cell containing a five-axis articulated robot arm with a commanded two-finger gripper, an input conveyor, an output conveyor, and a rigid package.
The cell must pick the freely moving package from the input conveyor, retain it during arm motion, release it onto the output conveyor, and move the released package away.
The evaluator runs the model from 0 s through 20 s.
